text: Welcome. I am Dr. Agent. You are presenting as a newborn with respiratory distress; tell me, how many hours has this been occurring, and was there a meconium-stained amniotic fluid during your mother's labor?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born after the 32nd gestational week. The baby was born via cesarean delivery. The mother had gestational diabetes but was otherwise healthy with no other pregnancy-related diseases.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS).

Given the history of preterm birth at 32 weeks, cesarean delivery, and maternal gestational diabetes, the clinical picture strongly suggests surfactant deficiency. Do you have any initial lab results or imaging available, such as an Arterial Blood Gas (ABG) or a Chest X-Ray, to confirm this? REQUEST TEST: ABG; REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_X-Ray
